messages:
naya: Heads-up  saw an uptick in 400s from v2 after the header-routing flip. Looks like clients that never sent X-Client-Version are being coerced to v2 and failing.

lee: saw it too. most failures are \"schema mismatch\" from older backend integrations. stack trace points at the new v2 deserializer.

aziz: we intentionally removed implicit routing for headerless to avoid silent slowdowns, but we also didn't ship a fallback affordance. maybe we need a short-lived tenant grace window.

pat: proposal: console exposes a per-tenant \"grace quota\" that routes up to N headerless QPS to v1 for 72h, with automatic decrement each hour. Defaults: N=5 QPS. Admins can raise it in UI.

naya: love that. add telemetry: how many unique client ids are missing header vs total. We'll need that to avoid whitelisting bots that spoof headers.

lee: routing snippet (rough):
```
match { if header(X-Client-Version) => v2;
        else if tenant.grace_quota_remaining > 0 => v1; else => v2 }
```
Also emit `X-Compat-Notice` when we apply grace.

aziz: capacity note: v1 pools are smaller and not autoscaling. Gate grace_by_region: only allow grace if v1.available_capacity > threshold. Otherwise reject and surface \"grace unavailable\" in console.

ops-bot: alert: v1-fallback-rate at us-west-2 = 6.8% for 5m. Paging eng-runtime oncall.

pat: add billing flag: mark grace-forwarded requests as \"compat-grace\" with non-billable metadata for the first calendar week so customers don't get surprised. Product to confirm.

naya: I'll draft a short opt-in flow for SEs: (1) enable grace per-tenant from console; (2) run telemetry for 72h; (3) offer bulk patch to migrate clients. Owners: pat (console), lee (telemetry), aziz (runtime guard).

lee: I'll add dashboard tiles: headerless_ratio, grace_consumption_QPS, v1_capacity_margin.

naya: thanks all. please DM if you see new errors. Closing thread, RFC to follow.
